propositions: Documentation batch F08–F20 requires implementation of seven approved tasks covering README, operation certificates, import batching, route discovery, MCP summaries, configuration contracts, and GitHub repository metadata.
F08A, F08B, F09, F10, F12, F13, and all three F19 units are approved; F02, F03, F04 are rejected; F05 is deferred.
F20 requires updating the GitHub About description via gh repo edit and verifying exact readback without changing files, topics, or homepage.
Generated artifacts must be changed only through their canonical sources; later children must be rebased on origin/main before gates when sharing generated artifacts.
Each repository child must pass applicable local checks, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and unresolved-comment gates before merge, then close without force.
